# anthropic_compliance_organizations (Data Source)

Lists every organization linked under the Claude Enterprise parent the key is bound to. Requires `compliance_api_key` (a Compliance Access Key) or an `enterprise_api_key` carrying the `read:compliance_org_data` scope; Admin API keys are rejected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_compliance_organizations" "all" {}

output "linked_organization_uuids" {
  value = data.anthropic_compliance_organizations.all.organizations[*].uuid
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `organizations` (Attributes List) Linked organizations, oldest first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--organizations))

<a id="nestedatt--organizations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `organizations`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Organization name.
- `uuid` (String) Organization UUID; the path parameter for the per-organization data sources.
